title: WIST Content Payload (WIST-3)
description: Size-cap profiles follow WIST-1 section 3.6, Size-cap parameter time, using the committing Delta for sealed Payloads.

content.description: The exact preimage of JCS(content), which the Delta's commitment covers (WIST-1 §3.6). WIST-1 §3.6 replaces the extract and link URL maxLength values with active JCS-octet caps. Summary title/abstract lengths remain independent scalar-value field limits. WIST-1 §7 assigns field and semantic diagnostics; duplicate or non-normalized string URLs retain E12. A validator MUST check octet caps itself.

links.description: The page's external links: `urls` is the first-N external Normalized URLs in raw-HTML document order (WIST-2's extraction procedure), `total` the count of ALL distinct external links before truncation. Each `urls` entry's `maxLength` is a code-point first pass; the octet caps (link_url_cap_bytes per URL, links_cap_bytes for JCS of this object) are stated in WIST-1 §3.6 and govern.
